subject.title: [Feature]: muteKeywords channel config — drop messages matching keyword/regex list before agent dispatch

question: Should OpenClaw accept `muteKeywords` as first-class per-channel config, route content suppression through a plugin/pre-routing hook, or decline this silent-drop behavior for now?
rationale: The request adds a new config surface and intentional message suppression across channel hot paths, while VISION and AGENTS guidance keep config growth and plugin/core ownership decisions under maintainer control.

options.title: Choose API Direction First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether channel config or a plugin/pre-routing hook is the canonical surface.

options.title: Approve Channel Config
options.body: Implement a narrow channel-owned `muteKeywords` option with safe regex validation, docs, schema updates, and Slack/Discord tests.

options.title: Defer To Pre-Routing Hook
options.body: Treat this as a plugin capability only after the pre-routing hook work lands and documents how to suppress matching messages.

recommendation.title: Choose API Direction First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether channel config or a plugin/pre-routing hook is the canonical surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent product and channel/config architecture trail among the relevant code paths.
